title: Kissed Nutty Ukrainian Fish Fillet Skewers
description: A festive Ukrainian dish featuring fish fillet, with a nutty and cheesy flavor, perfect for dinner parties.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the fish fillet into 1-inch pieces and season with salt and pepper.
Thread the fish pieces onto bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a bowl, mix together the sliced almonds, shredded parmesan cheese, chopped fresh dill, and minced garlic.
Brush the fish skewers with butter and then coat with the almond mixture, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the skewers on a bamboo tray lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the skewers with lemon juice and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Bake the skewers in the preheated oven for 12 minutes, or until the fish is cooked through and the almond topping is golden brown.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped fresh dill if desired.
